claim_verdicts.evidence: refs mirror, verbatim: "\"Default\" is not the default DNS policy. If `dnsPolicy` is not explicitly specified, then \"ClusterFirst\" is used."

refs mirror: "kubelet configures this file for each Pod" with example "search <namespace>.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local / options ndots:5". Capture at stage-3 (outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/dns-search.txt): "search network-lessons.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local", "nameserver 10.96.0.10", "options ndots:5" — no host search domains on donhang.

Execution only (resolv.conf(5) is not a docs root). Fewer than ndots: capture lines 6-11 show the three search domains in search-line order, then example.com. as written. At least ndots: Pod dns-ndots (same image caddy:2.10.0, ndots:1) looking up one-dot example.com logs only "example.com. NOERROR" (lines 17-24), so it was tried as written first. The fallback clause is gone from the claim and from section 4.

Execution: capture for `getent ahostsv4 example.com.` lists exactly one type A query, "example.com. NOERROR"; no search-domain name appears. Evidence is by execution on donhang only (resolv.conf(5) not a docs root).

Capture: "example.com.network-lessons.svc.cluster.local. NXDOMAIN / example.com.svc.cluster.local. NXDOMAIN / example.com.cluster.local. NXDOMAIN / example.com. NOERROR". Script line 29 keeps only `$1 == "A"` and de-duplicates (`!seen[$0]++`).

coredns.io kubernetes plugin: "It will handle all queries in that zone"; without fallthrough NXDOMAIN is the final answer (Corefile has fallthrough only for in-addr.arpa ip6.arpa). k8s refs: "forward: Any queries that are not within the Kubernetes cluster domain are forwarded to predefined resolvers (/etc/resolv.conf)." coredns.io forward: "sending all others requests to the servers defined in /etc/resolv.conf".

refs: "A query for `data.prod` returns the intended result, because it specifies the namespace." and "a query for just `data` may be expanded to `data.test.svc.cluster.local`." First search entry on donhang is network-lessons.svc.cluster.local (capture line 2); capture line 32: "(resolves to echo-ip's cluster IP)".

Round 3 recheck of changed s5 wording. dns-search.sh line 16 inserts `log` after `errors`; line 19 trap removes it on EXIT; lookup runs `getent ahostsv4`; queries() keeps only `$1 == "A"` and de-duplicates (`!seen[$0]++`). A records are IPv4 addresses, so s5 "the queries for IPv4 addresses ... each once, with their answers" matches the code. `show` (network-lessons.sh line 5) echoes the command, then runs it.

coredns.io log plugin: "By just using _log_ you dump all queries (and parts for the reply) on standard output." getent ahostsv4: getent(1) is not a docs root; supported by execution only — the getent call in the client Pod produced the logged queries to 10.96.0.10 (capture lines 6-11).
dns-config-pod.yaml lines 11-14: `dnsConfig: options: - name: ndots value: "1"`, no dnsPolicy. Capture: "options ndots:1" then "queries CoreDNS logged: example.com. NOERROR".

refs: "options ... The contents in this property will be merged to the options generated from the specified DNS policy." API ref PodDNSConfig.options: "Resolution options given in Options will override those that appear in the base DNSPolicy." PodDNSConfigOption: `value` — type string.

Narrowed claim no longer says what happens after the first try. First try as written: same resolver, same ndots:1 Pod, one-dot example.com went out as written first (capture lines 17-24); dots alone decide the order. Leaves the cluster: k8s refs "forward: Any queries that are not within the Kubernetes cluster domain are forwarded to predefined resolvers (/etc/resolv.conf)." echo-ip.network-lessons. is not under cluster.local. Not captured for this exact name.

Conditioned recommendation ("When a Pod mostly calls outside names"); each supporting fact is captured: final dot → one query, ndots:1 → one query for example.com, short name echo-ip resolves (capture lines 13-15, 17-24, 32). Not opinion-as-fact.

refs: "`Default`: The Pod inherits the name resolution configuration from the node that the Pods run on." Capture for dns-node: "nameserver 192.168.65.254", "options ndots:0", no search line; "getent hosts echo-ip" → "(no address)"; client → "(resolves to echo-ip's cluster IP)".

coredns.io cache: "cache enables a frontend cache"; "`disable` disable the success or denial cache for the listed ZONES." Captured Corefile on donhang: "cache 30 { disable success cluster.local / disable denial cluster.local }", supporting section 5 "does not cache answers under cluster.local" and section 6 "disable denial cluster.local". A cache inside CoreDNS only answers queries that reached CoreDNS.

refs, verbatim: "reload: Allows automatic reload of a changed Corefile. After you edit the ConfigMap configuration, allow two minutes for your changes to take effect." Section 7 now says "can also take up to two minutes", matching. The script waits until each CoreDNS Pod logs before looking up. Round 3 opened: lesson s5, meta claim 8, stage-3 dns-search.sh lines 20-40.
